Question:
What can be said about the shapes seen when viewing the same object from the front, side, and top?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_p113_q1_question_en.svg)

Choices.A: The shapes seen may be different
Choices.B: The shape must be the same
Choices.C: Only the front can be seen

Solution: The same object can appear to have different shapes when viewed from different directions.
